title: Profit Calculator
description: Compare crop profit by plot count, session length, and star bonus.
useCase: Choose the best crop before planting.

title: Fish Tracker
description: Track rare fish catches by water route, level gate, and time condition.

title: Crop Planner
description: Build an active, balanced, or offline crop route from playtime and plot count.
useCase: Turn a play window into a planting schedule.

title: Friendship Tracker
description: Estimate NPC routine progress from gifts, talks, and hangouts.
useCase: Plan one relationship loop for the week.

title: Recipe Finder
description: Filter starter recipes by ingredients you already have.
useCase: Choose what to cook before selling or gifting.

title: Daily Checklist
description: Save a repeatable daily route with presets for codes, crops, fish, and NPCs.

title: Route Timer
description: Run persistent timers for crops, cooking, fishing windows, and shop checks.
useCase: Know when to return to a route.
